root.name: Blackmar-Diemer Gambit Declined: O'Kelly Defense
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. e4 dxe4 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. f3 c6

overview: Black leaves the e4 pawn where it is and plays 4...c6 instead of taking on f3. White can regain the pawn with 5.fxe4 e5 or play 5.Bf4 exf3 6.Nxf3 and transpose to the Ziegler Defence. Most lines are a calm game where the pawn comes back and Black holds a solid set-up; I am not sure of the theory.

white_ideas.idea: Recapture on e4 with 5.fxe4 and develop with Nf3, Bd3 and Bf4 for a freer position.
Or play 5.Bf4 and recapture on f3 for the Ziegler-style attacking set-up.

black_ideas.idea: Answer 5.fxe4 with ...e5 to open the centre and trade pieces.
Play ...Bg4, ...e6 and ...Nbd7 to complete development and keep the pawn structure sound.

typical_structures.structure: White d4 and e4 after fxe4 against Black's c6 and d-pawn gone; open centre.

character.notes: Black keeps a solid set-up and White's attack is largely over; balanced middlegame.

gambit.notes: White can recapture on e4 at once, so no lasting material is given.

structure.notes: After fxe4 the centre opens with ...e5 and pieces trade.

approach.notes: BDG branches are chosen as surprise weapons and rarely by strong players.

level.notes: Few moves to know and clear ideas, but a niche choice.

sublines_that_differ.name: 5.Bf4 exf3
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. e4 dxe4 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. f3 c6 5. Bf4 exf3 6. Nxf3
sublines_that_differ.how: Transposes to the Ziegler Defence; White gambits a pawn for development.

character.reason: Black holds a solid set-up while White's attack fades.

gambit.reason: White can regain the pawn at once with fxe4.

soundness.reason: A quiet line where nothing is risked.

structure.reason: Pawns trade and the centre opens for the pieces.

approach.reason: BDG lines are rarely chosen by strong players.

level.reason: Simple ideas but a niche choice.

plans.reason: White relies on quick development after f3.
